name: Tina Kujo
source:
A cheeky and greedy waitress, who loves money and tries to rip off customers as much as she can.

[spoiler]Her real identity, along with [url=https://vndb.org/c45453]Tesse[/url]'s, is a terminal of Amaterasu. Her role is to observe people and their doings. In critical situations, she also can interfere in natural course of things, but only as minimal as necessary.[/spoiler]
